corrections: Use the approved concept itself as the construction source; exclude both rejected drafts and the darker runtime reduction.
Flood-fill only exterior neutral background, preserving enclosed pale eye pixels and genuine dark contours.
Align down and profile sampling to the actual source pupil columns and rows, without painting a generic eye template.
Reconstruct contiguous colour-region contours, including holes, as Blender Grease Pencil polygons and native SVG paths.
Compare actual final SVG-derived PNGs beside the concept at equal visible height and at 1x/2x game scale.

criteria.finding: Swept pointed locks and asymmetric silhouette follow the concept; the invented cap/spoke outline is removed.
Front retains two dark vertical pupils with pale outer accents. Profiles retain the source eye, nose and jaw relationship.
Head/body relationship, longer lower body, relaxed arms, knee/ankle separation and toe shapes follow the concept.
Thin crossed harness, substantial gloves, belt/cuffs and direction-specific scarf attachment follow the source.
Both reviewers inspected the exact export sheet and source comparison. Coarse details remain visible rather than hidden by source-only previews.

independentReviews.assessment: Closely matches the approved concept within 64px; no remaining material identity or anatomy mismatch. Suitable for reference-faithful idle-draft review.
Closely retains proportions, silhouette and equipment; no malformed anatomy or previous invented/cartoon face. Ready to present as idle draft.

limitations: Actual opaque silhouettes are 49px high within 64px cells.
Fine hair highlights, fingers/glove detail and buckle interior simplify at this scale.
Side profile nose/chin remains coarse at game resolution.
